title: Version 1.16.0
body:
Version 1.16.0

July 3rd, 2023

New Content:

  • Added the Elevator! (can be bought at Illumine)
  • Added the Blue Vinyl Player
  • Added 15 unique vinyls which can be bought all around the map
  • If two players hold a linked sword, you can now fight!
  • Mysterious Teacups and Kallostide now have Stat Tool details
  • New main region music by Chrythm

Changes:

  • Stat Tool no longer requires permission to view details
  • Various items are now moved around in stores
  • Internal changes to the placement system for structure data

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Stat Tool bug where clicking still detected last hovered object
